own_review.changed: none. Plan mode was switched on in this session (read-only), so I did not edit WP-17.md. The WP-17 fixes I would have made are listed in cross with target WP-17, so the orchestrator or a later non-plan run can apply them.

incoming.problem: Owner flag: the 'Also assumed from WP-01' line uses ViewerSpec{layout,swap_eyes,crop_aspect,screen,source}. There is no `screen` field.
incoming.fix: Replace it with `spec::ViewerSpec{pub layout: Layout, pub source: Source, pub swap_eyes: bool, pub crop_aspect: Option<f32>, pub screen_width_m: f32, pub distance_m: f32}` (derives Default) and `Layout{Sbs (default), Tab, SbsRev, TabRev}`. WP-17 reads only layout, swap_eyes and crop_aspect. Tests build specs as `ViewerSpec{layout: Layout::Sbs, crop_aspect: Some(16.0/9.0), ..ViewerSpec::default()}`. WP-19 passes screen_width_m into quad_size.

incoming.problem: The State strings are never given, but the tests require 'the exact line for each of the 4 states'. WP-19:91-92 uses `waiting-headset` and `waiting-source`.
incoming.fix: Add: as_str = WaitingHeadset→"waiting-headset", WaitingSource→"waiting-source", Showing→"showing", Error→"error". List the 4 exact lines in tests/status.rs, e.g. `{"state":"waiting-headset","fps":0.0,"w":0,"h":0}`.

incoming.problem: The TestPattern drawing is underspecified, and the test can fail or panic. (1) The liveness row has no colour. (2) No draw order is given: on seq 1 the row covers y=1..2, which crosses the mark pixel (2,2). (3) `seq % rh` panics when rh==0, i.e. when w<2 or h<2 makes an eye rect empty. (4) Rows y+1 and the 8x8 mark can spill outside a small rect.
incoming.fix: Specify all four: the liveness row is white [255,255,255,255]. Draw order: grey fill, then liveness row, then bar (full rect height), then marks last. Skip any eye whose rect has rw==0 or rh==0. Clip the row, bar and mark to the eye rect.

incoming.problem: The pacing has no start point, so whether the first fps>0 call is immediate is undefined.
incoming.fix: Specify: `next_at = Instant::now()` in new(). After returning a frame, `next_at += Duration::from_secs(1)/fps`. Ok(None) does not increment seq. The fps-1 / 10 ms test then gives Some, then None within 200 ms.

incoming.problem: The status round-trip cannot pass for 59.94 (it prints 59.9) or for NaN (NaN != NaN). The tall-eye crop test does not give the frame size.
incoming.fix: Round-trip only fps values with one decimal (59.9, 0.0); for 59.94 and NaN, assert the line only. Tall-eye test: frame 1920x1080 Sbs with crop 16/9 → [(0,270,960,540),(960,270,960,540)].

incoming.problem: In the done-check, `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<scratch>/target cargo test ... && cargo clippy ...` applies the variable to the first command only. The two clippy runs then write to the default target dir. It also says 'the viewer has no serde', but WP-01:90 gives the viewer serde.
incoming.fix: Use `export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<agent scratch>/target;` before the chain. Reword to 'no serde_json'. Spell out the full paths in **Files** (crates/viewer/src/status.rs, crates/viewer/src/source/test_pattern.rs, crates/viewer/tests/{layout,status}.rs) and add 'wave 2'.

incoming.problem: WP-17 lines 4-13 and 90 state a different frame.rs (Plane, FrameData::Mem, DmaBuf{planes}, fourcc, seq) and claim WP-01 froze it, which contradicts bones §2 (PixelFormat, Cpu, single-fd DmaBuf, no seq).
incoming.fix: Rewrite WP-17's frame block and TestPattern frame to the §2 form: Frame{width,height,format:PixelFormat::Bgra8,data:FrameData::Cpu{stride,bytes}}, with no seq field in Frame (TestPattern may keep a private seq).

incoming.problem: WP-17:12 assumes a ViewerSpec field `screen`. WP-01 names it screen_width_m (plus distance_m).
incoming.fix: Align with WP-01's frozen field names: screen_width_m and distance_m. There is no `screen` field.
